This is the lines-of-code cache for today.py. The workflow writes it, do not edit it by hand.
The first seven lines are this comment block, which today.py skips (comment_size=7 in __main__).
Every line below describes one repository, in the order the GitHub API returned it:
  sha256(owner/name)  commits on the default branch  my commits  additions  deletions
A repository is only re-queried when its commit count changes, which is what keeps the daily
run cheap. Delete one line to have that repository recounted on the next run, or delete the
whole file to recount every repository from scratch.
